manifest_metadata.description: Accurate epoch counts after full pipeline processing with SNR threshold criterion

step_001_parse_dynspec.note: Each observation file may contain multiple sub-integrations (epochs)

step_003_closure_delays.filtering: Epochs with valid triplet measurements (SNR >= 5.0 threshold criterion)

explanation: The 60 raw observation files from PPTA DR2 contain multiple sub-integrations. When parsed, these yield 10,201 individual epochs. The closure delay analysis requires specific ISM scintillation conditions and uses an SNR threshold criterion (min_snr=2.5) to address selection bias, resulting in 1,391 epochs with valid triplet measurements yielding 19,167 triplet delays. The independent epoch sample (n=1,093, epochs with ≥5 triplets) is used for primary inference.
